LuxNet.why: Vertically integrated optical component maker (InP CW DFB / EML laser chips, OSAs, optical engines) and OEM/ODM transceiver manufacturer whose products serve AI data centers (86.96% of 2025 sales to North America); 800G/1.6T and CW-laser demand for silicon photonics drives its revenue and capacity expansion.
LuxNet.evidence: LuxNet 2025 annual report: OEM/ODM one-stop manufacturing service for data centers covering 100G~1.6T optical engines and CoC packaging; CW DFB laser chips adopted by several major customers; developing 70/100mW CW LD for 800G/1.6T, CPO and silicon photonics.

players.product: InP laser chips (CW DFB, EML) and photodiodes, TO/OSA optical sub-assemblies, 100G-1.6T optical engines and transceivers, and transceiver OEM/ODM manufacturing

quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 revenue NT$1,289 million, up 8.0% QoQ and 18.6% YoY (Q2 2025: NT$1,087 million); gross profit NT$289 million; operating income NT$236 million; net income NT$184 million, EPS NT$1.29. H1 2026 revenue NT$2,482 million (+15.2% YoY), operating income NT$487 million

Manufacturing space (cleanroom): 1st plant Zhongli 5,450 m2; 2nd plant Zhongli 1,500 m2 (Q3 2025); 3rd plant Zhudong 1,200 m2 (rental, Q3 2026); 4th plant Bade 5,500 m2 (2027~). Total cleanroom 4,000 m2 at end-2024, 6,550 at end-2025, 8,150 at end-2026 and 13,650 at end-2027

Business lines on the deck: LD & PD/APD chips, OSA, optical engines, ELS, CoC and transceivers, sold as OEM/ODM, JDM and foundry business, including a high-value CW/EML chip foundry service; the deck shows an NPO optical module assembly process with FAU alignment. Company view: 800G ZR/ZR+ (which a cited research forecast shows starting volume shipments in 2026) is also a future growth driver for the company
